pages.title: The Diet Screen
pages.text: Open your inventory and click the $(thing)Diet button$() next to the recipe book.$(br2)At a glance you can see:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Nutrient bars$() for all six groups$(li)$(bold)Trend arrows$() — rising or falling$(li)$(bold)Calorie tracking$() for the day$(li)$(bold)Balance score$() — how evenly spread your diet is

pages.title: The Diet Screen
pages.text: Scroll down to see:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Recently eaten$() foods$(li)$(bold)Most neglected$() food groups$(li)$(bold)Most fatigued$() food families$(br2)$(italic)Check this screen before a big session — not after a debuff hits.$()
